sha.open: Open commit {{sha}} on {{host}} (opens in a new tab)

check.failed: Couldn't start the check. Try again.

reason.draftChanged: The draft changed while you were pulling. Reload it and try again.
reason.folderMissing: The stack's folder is no longer in the repository.
reason.tooLarge: The files are over the limits of a stack.

status.inSyncTip: {{ref}} is at {{sha}}, but nothing in {{folder}} changed.
status.behindTip_one: {{count}} commit changed this stack's folder since {{sha}}. {{ref}} is at {{head}}.
status.behindTip_other: {{count}} commits changed this stack's folder since {{sha}}. {{ref}} is at {{head}}.
status.behindTipCapped_other: At least {{count}} commits changed this stack's folder since {{sha}}. {{ref}} is at {{head}}.
status.sourceChangedNote: The repository, ref or folder is not the one that is deployed.

reason.hostKeyChanged: The host key for {{host}} has changed.
reason.hostKeyChangedNoHost: The host key of the repository's server has changed.
reason.hostKeyUntrusted: Host key not trusted yet. Confirm the key for {{host}}.
reason.hostKeyUntrustedNoHost: Host key not trusted yet. Confirm the key of the repository's server.
reason.refGoneNoRef: The branch or tag no longer exists.
reason.folderGoneNoFolder: The stack's folder no longer exists in the repository.
reason.checksFailedNoSha: The new commit didn't pass the checks: {{problem}}.
reason.checksFailedNoShaNoProblem: The new commit didn't pass the checks.
reason.autoDeployBlocked: Commit {{sha}} is waiting: {{problem}}. Nothing was deployed.
reason.autoDeployBlockedNoProblem: Commit {{sha}} is waiting. Nothing was deployed.
reason.autoDeployBlockedNoSha: The new commit is waiting: {{problem}}. Nothing was deployed.
reason.autoDeployBlockedNoShaNoProblem: The new commit is waiting. Nothing was deployed.

badge.behindTip_one: {{count}} commit changed this stack's folder since it was deployed. Review update.
badge.behindTip_other: {{count}} commits changed this stack's folder since it was deployed. Review update.
badge.behindTipCapped_other: At least {{count}} commits changed this stack's folder since it was deployed. Review update.
badge.behindSourceTip: The repository, ref or folder is not the one that is deployed. Review update.
badge.errorTip: The last check of the repository failed.

alert.title: {{name}} can't sync with {{repo}}
alert.body: {{reason}} The last good version, {{sha}}, is still running.

error.title: Couldn't load the git settings.
error.body: Check the connection and try again.

updates.title: Updates
updates.body: How Bayplan learns that the repository changed.
updates.helper: Stacks on the same repository share one check, and checks are spread out a little so a git host isn't hit all at once. Keep this on even with a webhook; it catches pushes the webhook missed.
updates.invalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 1440.
updates.saveFailed: Couldn't save the update settings. Try again.
updates.fixed: A fixed commit has nothing to check.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.body: Lets your git host tell Bayplan the moment something is pushed.

setup.title: Set up a webhook
setup.body: Pick your git host. Bayplan creates a secret address for this stack.
setup.exists: This stack already has a webhook.
setup.permission: You need Admin on this environment to set up a webhook.
setup.failed: Couldn't create the webhook. Try again.

once.title: Copy the secret now
once.body: Bayplan can't show it again. If you lose it, rotate the secret.

rows.pausedNote: {{owner}} set this webhook up and no longer has the access it needs, so requests to it do nothing. Hand it to an Admin of this environment from the user's page, or remove it.
rows.pausedNoteNoOwner: The person who set this webhook up no longer has the access it needs, so requests to it do nothing. Hand it to an Admin of this environment from the user's page, or remove it.

webhook.note: A webhook only tells Bayplan to check the repository. Bayplan ignores what the request says and fetches {{ref}} itself.

help.github: In the repository open Settings, then Webhooks, then Add webhook. Payload URL: the address above. Content type: application/json. Secret: the secret above. Events: just the push event.
help.gitlab: In the project open Settings, then Webhooks. URL: the address above. Secret token: the secret above. Trigger: push events.
help.gitea: In the repository open Settings, then Webhooks, then Add webhook, then Gitea or Forgejo. Target URL: the address above. Secret: the secret above. Trigger: push events.
help.generic: Send a POST request to the address whenever the repository changes.
help.genericHeader: Send the secret as an Authorization: Bearer header.

rotate.title: Rotate the webhook secret?
rotate.body: The old secret stops working at once. Update the webhook in {{host}} with the new one.
rotate.permission: You need Admin on this environment to rotate the secret.
rotate.failed: Couldn't rotate the secret. Try again.

remove.title: Remove the webhook?
remove.body: Pushes no longer reach {{name}} straight away. Polling still checks every {{minutes}} minutes. Remove the webhook in your git host too.
remove.bodyNoPolling: Pushes no longer reach {{name}} straight away, and polling is off, so Bayplan only sees changes when you check. Remove the webhook in your git host too.
remove.permission: You need Admin on this environment to remove the webhook.
remove.failed: Couldn't remove the webhook. Try again.

autoDeploy.title: Deploying
autoDeploy.body: Choose whether new commits deploy by themselves or wait for you.
autoDeploy.helperOff: A new commit that changes {{folder}} makes {{name}} show as behind. You review and deploy it.
autoDeploy.helperOn: A new commit that changes {{folder}} deploys without review, as {{user}}. A blocked change is skipped and shown as an error.
autoDeploy.fixed: A fixed commit has nothing to deploy.
autoDeploy.permission: You don't hold the permission to deploy here, so you can't turn on auto-deploy.

confirm.title: Turn on auto-deploy?
confirm.body: New commits to {{ref}} that change {{folder}} will deploy by themselves, without a review, as you. If you lose permission to deploy on {{environment}}, auto-deploy pauses. Changes that fail a check are skipped and shown as an error.

pausedAlert.title: Auto-deploy is paused
pausedAlert.body: {{user}} set it up and no longer has permission to deploy on {{environment}}. Transfer it to someone who can, or turn it off.
pausedAlert.bodyNoUser: The person who set it up no longer has permission to deploy on {{environment}}. Transfer it to someone who can, or turn it off.

rollbackAlert.title: Auto-deploy paused after rollback to #{{n}}
rollbackAlert.titleNoRevision: Auto-deploy paused after a roll back
rollbackAlert.body: {{name}} now waits for review. The repository head, {{sha}}, shows as pending.

source.title: Source
source.body: Where {{name}} comes from. Changing it goes through review.
source.needsAll: Choose a repository, a ref, a folder and at least one compose file.
source.conflict: {{user}} changed the source of {{name}} while you were editing. Reload to see it.
source.conflictUnknown: Someone changed the source of {{name}} while you were editing. Reload to see it.
source.repoGone: That repository isn't available on this environment.
source.permission: You don't have permission to change the source.
source.draftFailed: Couldn't read the draft. Check the connection and try again.

detach.title: Detach from git
detach.body: Turn {{name}} back into an inline stack you edit in Bayplan. The files now deployed become an editable draft. Bayplan stops checking the repository, removes the webhook and turns off auto-deploy. Nothing running changes.
detach.permission: You don't have permission to detach this stack.
detach.failed: Couldn't detach the stack. Check the connection and try again.

dialog.title: Detach {{name}} from git?
dialog.body: Revision #{{revision}} (commit {{sha}}) is copied into an editable draft. Bayplan stops checking {{repo}}, removes the webhook and turns off auto-deploy. Nothing running changes. You can point the stack at a repository again later.
dialog.bodyNoRevision: The files of the stack are copied into an editable draft. Bayplan stops checking {{repo}}, removes the webhook and turns off auto-deploy. Nothing running changes. You can point the stack at a repository again later.
